subject: Aligning time windows for SI + Marketplace architecture deep-dive
thread_body:
From: Asha Patel <asha@blueorbit.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: leo@cloudmarketplace.io
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposal: SI + Marketplace architecture deep-dive (2x proposed windows)

Hi Aisha and team,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. BlueOrbit's integration lead and marketplace PM would like to run a focused architecture deep-dive to align on the connector responsibilities, ingest/transform flow, and SSO/SCIM requirements before we start dev.

Proposed 90-minute windows (all in PT):
- Wed, 24 Jun — 10:00–11:30 PT
- Thu, 25 Jun — 14:00–15:30 PT

Rough attendee list: BlueOrbit integration lead (me), Marketplace infra (Leo Kim), Redwood platform eng (Aisha R.), Redwood marketplace PM (Camila R.).

Attached a one-page outline (BO-SI-arch-outline.pdf). Can you confirm availability and whether we should include any security/compliance folks (SOC2 evidence/retention) or product analytics? Also let us know if you prefer a shorter 60-minute run with a follow-up lab.

Best,
Asha Patel
Head of Integrations, BlueOrbit Systems
[Attachment: BO-SI-arch-outline.pdf (PDF)]

-----
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: Asha Patel <asha@blueorbit.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 18:05:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: SI + Marketplace architecture deep-dive (2x proposed windows)

Hi Asha — thanks for the outline, looks good.

Quick availability notes from our side (PT):
- Wed, 24 Jun 10:00–11:30 PT — tentative OK, but Jorge (our infra ops) is on vacation that week; we can cover infra questions with Jonas + Sergio.
- Thu, 25 Jun 14:00–15:30 PT — better for our marketplace engineers (they have a freeze on 24th).

Can we aim for Thu 25 Jun 14:00–15:30 PT as primary, with Wed 24 Jun 10:00–11:30 PT as a backup? Please confirm attendee list and whether you want recordings enabled and a shared Miro/Confluence.

I'll prepare a short run-of-show template and drop it in the calendar invite.

Cheers,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

-----
From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, Asha Patel <asha@blueorbit.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: SI + Marketplace architecture deep-dive (2x proposed windows)

Aisha / Asha — we should be deliberate about who needs to attend from Marketplace infra. Leo, can you confirm if your infra lead can join Thu 25 Jun 14:00 PT? Our engs have a deploy freeze on the 24th so the 25th is preferable.

Also attaching a short agenda draft for a 90-min session that splits design (45m) and hands-on config discussion (30m) + 15m Q&A. If we want a shorter 60-min session, I can trim the config portion and schedule a follow-up lab.

[Attachment: workshop-agenda-20260524.docx]

Camila Reyes
Marketplace PM | Redwood Console

-----
From: Asha Patel <asha@blueorbit.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: leo@cloudmarketplace.io
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 13:10:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: SI + Marketplace architecture deep-dive (2x proposed windows)

Thanks — Thu 25 Jun 14:00 PT works for us. One ask: can we shift it 30 minutes later (14:30 PT) to accommodate an internal exec call? If that's a problem we can take the Wed backup, but we'd prefer Thu 25 Jun 14:30–16:00 PT.

Leo: booking note — we will need the marketplace onboarding owner and whoever manages the catalog ingestion to be on the call.

I've created a provisional Zoom invite (will share link after you confirm): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=workshop

Asha

-----
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com, Asha Patel <asha@blueorbit.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 18:03:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: SI + Marketplace architecture deep-dive (2x proposed windows)

Confirmed for Thu 25 Jun 14:30–16:00 PT (we'll block 90 minutes on the calendar).

Run-of-show:
- 14:30–14:40 Introductions + goals (Aisha)
- 14:40–15:20 Architecture walk (Sergio + BlueOrbit lead)
- 15:20–15:50 Config & edge cases (Jonas + Leo)
- 15:50–16:00 Next steps & action items (Camila + Asha)

I'll enable recording and add the Confluence page: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/si-workshop-BO-1294

Thanks, looking forward to it.

Jonas Weber
Senior Platform Engineer | Redwood Inference
